name: @red-cup-engineering/gambling-trainer-561-group
description: gambling-trainer.561.group — 'Kelly's Wager': a daily-seeded bankroll-survival trainer that teaches expected value, variance, and Kelly sizing by play, against a practice-only bankroll (earn-only; no real currency ever enters or leaves). Every offered wager is graded against the real Kelly optimum, and every spend in the UI is typed on screen as freely-reversible, priced, or terminal, per the house's disclosure discipline.

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit --noCheck --allowImportingTsExtensions --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target esnext src/*.mts web/test/*.test.mts && for f in web/js/*.mjs web/server.mjs; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
